_comment: Group reputation (1-5, fractional allowed) starting values. Default is 3; these curated overrides set distinct starting points. Applied onto groups.json / scenario_6 groups as `reputation`. From there reputation is dynamic in-engine: up with accrued member tenure and well-handled (special-live) graduations; down with scandals + handling and core members leaving without recognition.

scale.1: Fragile brand — little public trust buffer; scandals hit hard
scale.2: Low reputation — indie / volatile fanbase; soft keeps look weak
scale.4: Strong reputation — established act; some scandal resilience
scale.5: Elite reputation — national-scale trust; soft handling still costly at high severity

overrides.note: High visibility but low public-trust buffer; Budokan-era scandals read as brand-fragile.
Long-tenured academy flagship; the Nonno scandal was handled properly, so strong mainstream goodwill holds just below elite.
As of scenario 6: long tenure and only the minor Mirei scandal — elite public trust.
Mid-to-long tenure with no scandal on record; strong brand just below elite.
Rising mainstream profile; suspension culture is visible but brand still solid.
Long-running LIVE PLANET act with deep historical tenure (past members included), and only the single Kanon scandal — average, not fragile.
